verdict.rationale: Attio documents a public JSON REST API with a published OpenAPI 3.1 spec. It covers objects, records, lists and webhooks, and lets apps read and write workspace data, so the core CRM data surface is programmable. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows UI parity: UI features such as workflow building, reporting dashboards, workspace and object settings, and enabling the Deal object (described as an admin action on the settings page) have no documented API equivalent. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity commitment, API coverage of workflows, reporting and admin/settings actions, and independent hands-on corroboration of breadth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Attio provides a public REST API which exchanges JSON over HTTPS.
This allows developers to build apps that read and write information to and from Attio workspaces.
describing the public REST endpoints (objects, records, lists, webhooks) with schemas.
Attio exposes a public OpenAPI specification for the Attio REST API.
